title: Collision forgery
attack: Black-box hill climbing (4000 iterations, fingerprint distance only) perturbs an unrelated photograph until its PDQ approaches a registered image's.
outcome: Distance went from 132 to 62 (threshold 31). Verdict on the forged image: NO_RECORD. Watermark z against the registered image's seed: -0.93 (decision threshold 6), so it can never be AUTHORED.
